messages.subject: Error: M2 cannot be calulated since df is too low
parts:
Hey all,

I guess I just have too many code error when I was trying to get M2() statistics. 
I am using mirt to run Uni-dimensional IRT for 9 items, imputed missing dataset, obs=470. 
Everything works fine except M2(): Error: M2 cannot be calulated since df is too low

I am wondering how could I solve this issue? Or is there any alternative options for checking model fit indices?

Thanks a lot! Any comment is welcome!
Yingyi

messages.subject: Re: Error: M2 cannot be calulated since df is too low
parts:
This is mainly a problem with the M2* implementation, which has been discussed a few times in this forum. Improvements to this method are possible, but I haven't found the time to implement these in the package yet. 

Phil
